extracted.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
extracted.description: Crispy exterior, chewy interior and chocolate all throughout. This recipe is the perfect mix between everyone’s favorite chocolate chip cookie!
instruction_lines: Brown 1/2 cup butter, then add cubed butter and melt together. Let cool.
Mix melted butters with dark brown sugar, white sugar, egg, egg yolk, and vanilla.
Add all-purpose flour, cake flour, and baking soda. Mix until just combined.
Fold in rough chopped chocolate and chocolate chips.
Sprinkle sea salt on cookies right after baking.
